summary:
Research handoff recording the third confirmed in-scope violation plus one new low-consequence lead; preflight-validated with valid=True and no diagnostics.

Third finding confirmed: direct check 7815ca48454b4d919a20810718683b41 executed its fixed bytes as 554a0abcf056483ba255f00545e30713 with the declarative prerequisite matched, comparison_complete and witness_complete true, and the implication false — a TimeoutNow whose sender was absent from the receiver's bootstrapped two-voter configuration was honoured exactly like the configured-sender control (leader node2 cleared, state Follower to Candidate, privilege false to true, no error), while the out-of-window control was rejected with ErrUnsupportedProtocol and changed nothing, so the RPC-header version window is the only guard on that path. The blocking review issue (API documentation characterising leadership transfer as safe in mixed clusters versus the handler granting the privileged election path without the membership check the vote RPCs apply) was resolved as an independent scope boundary rather than by weakening the claim.

Product contents: the draft map (base version 8) records the observed conditional relationship on b-timeout-now and narrows the f-leader-transfer-privilege unknown to real reachability and design intent, and adds one new low-consequence deferred Surface for ReloadConfig's notification scope (it notifies the notify channels only for a decreased HeartbeatTimeout, so a decreased LeaderLeaseTimeout is not signalled and the current leader lease timer keeps the old value until it fires). Feedback carries the reference set and the remaining discriminators. Impact is clarification/dependency only — no meaning, identity, edge, requirement or previously accepted Surface disposition changed, so all three confirmed findings keep their original basis.

Run state: map accepted at version 8 with three confirmed in-scope violations (batching-FSM ConfigurationStore delivery; heartbeat fast-path header gate; TimeoutNow sender attribution), no pending review work, and remaining leads (real reachability of a non-member sender, whether the grant can unseat a healthy leader, the reload-timer question, and the still-unread observer/RecoverCluster/snapshot-store/net_transport paths).
